emails.linkFallback: Button not working? Copy this link into your browser: <link>{url}</link>

magicLink.subject: Your Adiutor sign-in link
magicLink.preview: Your link to sign in to Adiutor
magicLink.reason: You're receiving this because someone asked to sign in to Adiutor with this email address. If that wasn't you, you can ignore this email: nobody can sign in without this link.
magicLink.heading: Sign in to Adiutor
magicLink.body: {minutes, plural, one {Use the button below to sign in. The link works once and expires in # minute.} other {Use the button below to sign in. The link works once and expires in # minutes.}}

resetPassword.subject: Reset your Adiutor password
resetPassword.preview: Choose a new password for Adiutor
resetPassword.reason: You're receiving this because someone asked to reset the password for this email address. If that wasn't you, you can ignore this email: your password stays the same.
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset the password of your Adiutor account. Choose a new one with the button below. The link expires in 1 hour.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your Adiutor email address
verifyEmail.preview: Confirm this is your email address
verifyEmail.reason: You're receiving this because someone asked to verify this email address for an Adiutor account. If that wasn't you, you can ignore this email.
verifyEmail.heading: Verify your email address
verifyEmail.body: Confirm that this email address belongs to you. Once it's verified, accounts with the same address at a provider you can sign in with (such as GitHub) can connect to your account automatically. The link expires in 1 hour.

twoFactorCode.subject: Your Adiutor sign-in code
twoFactorCode.reason: You're receiving this because someone signed in to Adiutor with your password, or turned on email codes for your account. If that wasn't you, change your password right away.
twoFactorCode.heading: Your sign-in code
twoFactorCode.intro: Enter this code in Adiutor to continue:
twoFactorCode.note: {minutes, plural, one {The code expires in # minute. Never share it with anyone.} other {The code expires in # minutes. Never share it with anyone.}}

invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to join {company} on Adiutor
invitation.reason: You're receiving this because {inviter} invited this email address to {company}. If you weren't expecting it, you can ignore this email.
invitation.heading: Join {company}
invitation.body: {inviter} invited you to join {company} on Adiutor as {role}.
invitation.note: {days, plural, one {The link works once and expires in # day. You can sign in with an existing account or create one.} other {The link works once and expires in # days. You can sign in with an existing account or create one.}}

invitationReminder.subject: Reminder: join {company} on Adiutor
invitationReminder.reason: You're receiving this because {inviter} invited this email address to {company} and the invitation hasn't been accepted yet. If you weren't expecting it, you can ignore this email.
invitationReminder.heading: Your invitation expires soon
invitationReminder.body: {inviter} invited you to join {company} on Adiutor as {role}. The invitation is still open until {expires}.
invitationReminder.note: This link replaces the one in the earlier email, which no longer works. It works once.

inviteLinkConfirmation.subject: Confirm your email to join {company}
inviteLinkConfirmation.preview: One more step to join {company} on Adiutor
inviteLinkConfirmation.reason: You're receiving this because someone used an invite link for {company} with this email address. If that wasn't you, you can ignore this email.
inviteLinkConfirmation.heading: Confirm your email address
inviteLinkConfirmation.body: You opened an invite link for {company}. Confirm this is your email address to join as {role}.
inviteLinkConfirmation.note: {days, plural, one {The link works once and expires in # day.} other {The link works once and expires in # days.}}

alreadyMember.subject: You're already a member of {company} on Adiutor
alreadyMember.reason: You're receiving this because someone tried to invite this email address to {company}.
alreadyMember.heading: You're already a member
alreadyMember.body: Someone tried to invite you to {company} on Adiutor, but you're already a member. No action is needed.

alreadyInvited.subject: You already have an invitation to {company} on Adiutor
alreadyInvited.reason: You're receiving this because someone used an invite link for {company} with this email address. If that wasn't you, you can ignore this email.
alreadyInvited.heading: You already have an invitation
alreadyInvited.body: You opened an invite link for {company} on Adiutor, but this email address already has an open invitation there. Use the invitation email you received earlier to join.
alreadyInvited.expired: If that invitation has expired, ask whoever invited you to send you a new one.

addedToCompany.subject: You were added to {company} on Adiutor
addedToCompany.preview: You now have access to {company} on Adiutor
addedToCompany.reason: You're receiving this because {adder} added your account to {company}.
addedToCompany.heading: You were added to {company}
addedToCompany.body: {adder} added you to {company} on Adiutor as {role}.

accountCreated.subject: Your Adiutor account is ready
accountCreated.reason: You're receiving this because {creator} of {staff} created an Adiutor account for this email address. If you weren't expecting it, you can ignore this email.
accountCreated.heading: Your Adiutor account is ready
accountCreated.body: {creator} of {staff} created an Adiutor account for you. Choose a password to sign in.
accountCreated.note: {days, plural, one {The link works once and expires in # day. You can also sign in with a link sent to this address at {signInUrl}.} other {The link works once and expires in # days. You can also sign in with a link sent to this address at {signInUrl}.}}

staffAdminAdded.subject: {name} is now a staff Admin on Adiutor
staffAdminAdded.preview: {name} is now a staff Admin on Adiutor
staffAdminAdded.reason: You're receiving this because you're a staff Admin on Adiutor: staff Admins are told whenever someone becomes one.
staffAdminAdded.heading: {name} is now a staff Admin
staffAdminAdded.madeBy: {by} made {who} a staff Admin on Adiutor.
staffAdminAdded.made: {who} was made a staff Admin on Adiutor.
staffAdminAdded.acceptedFrom: {who} accepted {by}’s invitation and is now a staff Admin on Adiutor.
staffAdminAdded.accepted: {who} accepted an invitation to the staff and is now a staff Admin on Adiutor.
staffAdminAdded.advice: Staff Admins can manage everything on Adiutor, the staff included. If you don't recognise this, remove their staff access on the staff page and check the audit log.

securityNotice.reason: {kind, select, password_sign_in_paused {You're receiving this because of failed sign-in attempts on your Adiutor account. We send it at most once a day.} account_deleted {You're receiving this because your Adiutor account was deleted. We send it once, to the address the account had.} two_factor_locked {You're receiving this because of failed sign-in attempts on your Adiutor account. We send it once each time signing in with a code is paused.} other {You're receiving this because a security setting changed on your Adiutor account. We always send these, so you know about every change.}}
securityNotice.ifNotYou: {kind, select, account_deactivated {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} company_role_changed {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} removed_from_company {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} account_deleted {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} password_sign_in_paused {If this wasn't you, someone may be guessing your password. Make sure it's one you don't use anywhere else, or add a passkey.} two_factor_locked {If this wasn't you, someone may know your password. Change it right away, and make sure it's one you don't use anywhere else.} other {If this wasn't you, reset your password right away and contact your administrator.}}

password_changed.subject: Your Adiutor password was changed
password_changed.heading: Your password was changed
password_changed.body: The password of your Adiutor account was changed, and you were signed out on your other devices.

password_added.subject: A password was added to your Adiutor account
password_added.heading: A password was added
password_added.body: You can now also sign in to Adiutor with your email address and this password.

password_reset.subject: Your Adiutor password was reset
password_reset.heading: Your password was reset
password_reset.body: The password of your Adiutor account was reset with a link sent to this address, and you were signed out everywhere.

two_factor_enabled.subject: Two-step verification is on for your Adiutor account
two_factor_enabled.heading: Two-step verification is on
two_factor_enabled.body: Signing in to Adiutor with your password now also needs a code.

two_factor_disabled.subject: Two-step verification was turned off on your Adiutor account
two_factor_disabled.heading: Two-step verification was turned off
two_factor_disabled.body: Signing in to Adiutor with your password no longer needs a code.

backup_codes_regenerated.subject: New backup codes for your Adiutor account
backup_codes_regenerated.heading: You have new backup codes
backup_codes_regenerated.body: New backup codes were created for your Adiutor account. Your old backup codes no longer work.

passkey_added.subject: A passkey was added to your Adiutor account
passkey_added.heading: A passkey was added
passkey_added.body: A new passkey can now be used to sign in to your Adiutor account.

passkey_removed.subject: A passkey was removed from your Adiutor account
passkey_removed.heading: A passkey was removed
passkey_removed.body: One of your passkeys can no longer be used to sign in to Adiutor.

provider_connected.subject: {provider} was connected to your Adiutor account
provider_connected.heading: {provider} was connected
provider_connected.body: You can now sign in to Adiutor with your {provider} account.

provider_disconnected.subject: {provider} was disconnected from your Adiutor account
provider_disconnected.heading: {provider} was disconnected
provider_disconnected.body: Your {provider} account can no longer be used to sign in to Adiutor.

mfa_reset.subject: Your Adiutor two-step verification was reset
mfa_reset.heading: Your two-step verification was reset
mfa_reset.body: An administrator turned off two-step verification on your Adiutor account, usually because a phone was lost. Any GitHub or Google accounts connected to your Adiutor account were disconnected, and you were signed out everywhere. Set up two-step verification again on your Security page.

signed_out_everywhere.subject: You were signed out of Adiutor
signed_out_everywhere.heading: You were signed out everywhere
signed_out_everywhere.body: An administrator signed your Adiutor account out on every device. Sign in again to continue.

account_deactivated.subject: Your Adiutor account was deactivated
account_deactivated.heading: Your account was deactivated
account_deactivated.body: Your Adiutor account was deactivated, and you can't sign in until an administrator reactivates it.

account_reactivated.subject: Your Adiutor account was reactivated
account_reactivated.heading: Your account was reactivated
account_reactivated.body: An administrator reactivated your Adiutor account. You can sign in again.

staff_role_granted.subject: You now have staff access to Adiutor
staff_role_granted.heading: You now have staff access
staff_role_granted.body: An administrator made you staff on Adiutor, as {role}. You can now work with every company.

staff_role_changed.subject: Your Adiutor staff role changed
staff_role_changed.heading: Your staff role changed
staff_role_changed.body: An administrator changed your staff role on Adiutor to {role}.

staff_role_removed.subject: Your Adiutor staff access was removed
staff_role_removed.heading: Your staff access was removed
staff_role_removed.body: An administrator removed your staff access on Adiutor. Your account and any company memberships stay.

password_sign_in_paused.subject: Password sign-in to your Adiutor account is paused
password_sign_in_paused.heading: Password sign-in is paused
password_sign_in_paused.body: A wrong password was entered for your Adiutor account too many times, so signing in with a password is paused for a while. No one signed in: the password wasn't accepted. You can still sign in with an email link or a passkey, and resetting your password lifts the pause.

company_role_changed.subject: Your role in {company} on Adiutor changed
company_role_changed.heading: Your role in {company} changed
company_role_changed.body: Your role in {company} on Adiutor was changed to {role}.

removed_from_company.subject: You were removed from {company} on Adiutor
removed_from_company.heading: You were removed from {company}
removed_from_company.body: You were removed from {company} on Adiutor, so you can no longer open it. Your account and your other companies stay.

account_deleted.subject: Your Adiutor account was deleted
account_deleted.heading: Your account was deleted
account_deleted.body: An administrator deleted your Adiutor account, with its sign-in methods and company memberships. You can't sign in with it any more.

two_factor_locked.subject: Signing in to your Adiutor account with a code is paused
two_factor_locked.heading: Signing in with a code is paused
two_factor_locked.body: A wrong code was entered for your Adiutor account's two-step verification too many times, so signing in with a code is paused for 15 minutes. No one signed in: the codes weren't accepted.
